props.gloss_en: [the mishnah's clause, cited:] if he did not grind [the cumin] on Shabbat eve -- [he chews it with his teeth and places it]
the baraita: grinding cumin is among the things not done for circumcision on Shabbat
the baraita: on Yom Tov one grinds cumin for it
the baraita: mixing wine and oil is among the things not done for circumcision on Shabbat
the baraita: on Yom Tov one mixes wine and oil for it
Abaye: what is different about cumin on Yom Tov? that it is fit for the pot
Abaye: wine and oil are also fit on Shabbat, for a sick person
one does not mix wine and oil for a sick person on Shabbat
R' Meir: one even mixes wine and oil [for a sick person on Shabbat]
R' Shimon ben Elazar: once R' Meir had pain in his bowels; we sought to mix wine and oil for him and he did not let us
R' Meir: though I say thus and my colleagues say thus, never in my days did my heart permit me to transgress my colleagues' words
it was he who was strict with himself
there [for the sick] it need not be beaten
here [for circumcision] it must be beaten
here too, let him make it and not beat it
[the mishnah, cited:] he places this by itself and that by itself
that is what [the mishnah] teaches: he places this by itself and that by itself

supports.gloss_en: היינו דקתני: נותן זה בפני עצמו וזה בפני עצמו -- the mishnah's wording is this very practice

objections.gloss_en: אמר ליה אביי לרב יוסף: מאי שנא כמון ביום טוב -- דחזי לקדרה; יין ושמן חזי נמי בשבת לחולה, דתניא... אף טורפין -- by the same reason wine and oil should be permitted for circumcision on Shabbat

answered_by.gloss_en: התם לא בעי ליכא, הכא בעי ליכא -- for the sick it need not be beaten; for circumcision it must be, so the two differ (= p_choleh_lo_baei_lilach, p_mila_baei_lilach)

objections.gloss_en: אמרנו לו: דבריך יבטלו בחייך?! -- you permit it; shall your own ruling be voided in your lifetime by your refusal?

answered_by.gloss_en: אף על פי שאני אומר כך וחבירי אומרים כך, מימי לא מלאני לבי לעבור על דברי חבירי (= p_rm_lo_laavor_al_divrei_chaverav)
